body.objective: Expand the Rt-affiliated dressed scalar source on the published free Appendix-C oscillator map and covariant squeezed vacuum, prove its exact finite-mode normalization, and decide whether the explicit leading source is sufficient for the lambda^8 detector probability coefficient.
activates: an explicit scalar Jordan-oscillator source normal form on the finite detector core
a proof that unknown nonlinear Rt source corrections do not affect the leading lambda^8 probability
a sharp separation between finite-core preparation and the obstructed ordinary-Fock infrared limit
body.current_gate: Pull the positive three-particle source and target vacuum through the covariant leading Appendix-C map, retain all Z powers and the squeezed-vacuum factor, prove the cross-CCR normalization for three distinct momenta, and perform exact perturbative order counting.
body.stop_condition: Land an exact certificate and method-distinct verifier for the explicit leading source, vacuum annihilation identities, charge/orbit branches, norm, ghost parity and lambda-order sufficiency, while preserving the ordinary-Fock infrared obstruction and all general Eq. 19 boundaries.
body.forbid: no bare scalar Fock vacuum substituted for the pulled squeezed vacuum; no fixed-vacuum Z=1 quotient used with covariant charge; no finite-mode vector called a thermodynamic Fock vector; no leading normal form called the full nonlinear Rt; no standard P_chi, all-time probability, gravity, BRST, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion
body.resource_hint: Use d_Upsilon^dagger=Z^-1 a1^dagger/sqrt(2E) and d_Omega^dagger=Z(a2^dagger-2iEt a1^dagger+exp(-2iEt)a1(-p))/(4E^2 sqrt(2E)). On |0_phi;t>=Rt^dagger|0_BT>, both pulled annihilators vanish and the last term drops. The cross commutator is (2E)^3/[sqrt(2E) 4E^2 sqrt(2E)]=1. For three distinct modes, the two pure-species branches are null and their cross pairings are one. The complete tree amplitude begins at lambda^4, so psi=psi0+O(lambda) has probability lambda^8 ||A4 psi0||^2+O(lambda^9).
